title: Ep 53 — Gemini 4 Argon arrives behind a velvet rope, and the QR-code photo wall clearing thirty-seven thousand dollars a month
description: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon at the same introductory price as Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol but limits it to cyber defenders for now, the US FTC opens a probe into the major AI labs, and Anthropic sets a 30 November retirement date for Claude Sonnet 4.5. Plus a deep dive on QR-code event photo sharing, backed by a Stripe-verified German listing with over half a million dollars all-time, niched as an adults-first Clubhouse Photo Wall, and Meridian FC named on air for the first time as EV-Partnerships' first installed club charger alongside Be.EV's new monthly charging passes.
